ring: AGENTIC AI · LLM SYSTEMS · EVALS · GUARDRAILS ·

projects.name: hopcite
projects.tagline: Where plain vector RAG fails on multi-hop questions, and how to fix it safely.
projects.description: Hybrid knowledge-graph and vector RAG over 18 SEC filings. Multi-hop accuracy rose from 38% to 63% against a vector-only baseline (3-hop: 20% → 50%). Every claim carries a validated citation, and the model never writes Cypher.

projects.name: tracedresearch
projects.tagline: Agents run as a real service, not a demo: crash-safe, budgeted and traced.
projects.description: LangGraph research agents that survive a hard kill (SIGKILL) and resume from the last committed step, without re-running completed steps. Median 65 s and about $0.0009 per run across 15 runs; 72 of 72 citations in the final reports pass validation. Spending caps are enforced in code before every LLM call.

projects.name: llmfailover
projects.tagline: Infrastructure and on-call thinking: when an LLM provider goes down, requests route around it.
projects.description: An OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway with circuit breakers and automatic failover. Answered 100% of requests through a 2-minute outage of the primary runtime, and 83.9% when both local runtimes went down for 90 s and traffic failed over to Groq. No duplicate side effects across 141 retried requests.

projects.name: kappajudge
projects.tagline: Evaluations measured instead of trusted: an LLM judge checked against humans.
projects.description: An LLM judge calibrated against HelpSteer2 human ratings: mean agreement 0.49 (quadratic-weighted kappa) against 0.53 between the human raters themselves. Position and length biases are quantified, and a CI release gate fails a PR that weakens the prompt.

projects.name: distillroi
projects.tagline: Unit economics: when a small distilled model beats paying for a frontier API.
projects.description: A 1.5B QLoRA student reaches 90% of a 120B teacher's accuracy at 78 ms p50 instead of 443 ms. A confidence router that escalates 28% of traffic to the teacher reaches 99.7%. Served on vLLM, self-hosting breaks even with the API at about 313K requests/day.

projects.name: mcpsum
projects.tagline: Stop MCP servers from rug-pulling your AI agent.
projects.description: A lockfile and runtime reference monitor for MCP tools, like go.sum for the tools your agent trusts. Definitions are served from the mcp.lock you reviewed, so text a server swaps in after approval never reaches the model.

projects.name: MergeCode
projects.tagline: This patch passes tests. Would a maintainer merge it?
projects.description: Judges AI-generated patches the way a reviewer does: runs your checks, catches the tricks that get code to green (deleted asserts, skipped tests, new deps, CI edits) and returns a verdict with evidence.

projects.name: VibeForge
projects.tagline: Describe the moment. Get a playlist that fits it.
projects.description: An agentic playlist generator: a mood analyst, a curator and a critic work through a LangGraph state machine to turn plain language into ten well-balanced tracks. Accepted into the 500-AI-Agents-Projects repository.

projects.name: Graph RAG
projects.tagline: Answers from your documents and the connections between them.
projects.description: Qdrant vector search plus Neo4j graph facts, cited and streamed over FastAPI SSE. Runs fully local on Ollama or on Hugging Face, with a golden-set eval harness and Langfuse tracing.
